note: Scenario presets for the RE:GEN City Simulator. Values override sim.js DEFAULTS. Simulation, not a forecast.

scenarios.name: Anchor tenant signed
scenarios.description: A streamer or studio contracts 2 stages for 150 days a year.

scenarios.name: No international demand
scenarios.description: International productions at 30% of plan; no rebate.

scenarios.name: Kwanza crisis
scenarios.description: A one-off 32% fall plus 10% drift; indexation recovers 70% each quarter.

scenarios.name: Construction delay (9 months)
scenarios.description: The site opens 9 months late in the operating year.

scenarios.name: Energy partner withdraws
scenarios.description: No solar plant; grid plus diesel back-up.

scenarios.name: Grid failures
scenarios.description: Three times as many outages, up to 5 days each.

scenarios.name: Skills shortage
scenarios.description: Fewer skilled local crew; academy output at 40%.

scenarios.name: Political or permit delay
scenarios.description: A 90-day permit hold and more frequent protests.

scenarios.name: Production rebate passed
scenarios.description: A national cash rebate lifts international arrivals 50%.

scenarios.name: Finance phased case (USD 93M Wave 1 debt)
scenarios.description: Wave 1 debt from the phased financial model, 2026-10-27.
